step-2.title: Dry and Refrigerated Port Storage
step-2.description: Multi-zone, temperature-controlled storage at ports of origin to prevent moisture deterioration and pest infestations.

step-3.title: Multi-Agency Quality Control and Compliance
step-3.description: 100% testing of every batch for pesticide residues, heavy metals, microbiological contamination and compliance with FDA/EU labels.

step-4.title: Direct delivery to wholesalers
step-4.description: Delivery with vehicles equipped with hydraulic tail lifts, directly to the distribution centers of wholesalers and supermarkets.

test-1.highlight: The Tata Tea tastes exactly like the one from home in India
test-1.quote: I've been buying my chai and dal from Shelly Indian Foods for years now. The Tata Tea Premium tastes exactly like the one my mother used to make in India, and deliveries throughout Italy have always been fast and reliable. It's rare to find such an authentic store.
test-1.author: Rakesh S.

test-2.highlight: Everything is carefully chosen, not just imported in bulk
test-2.quote: I'm not Indian, but I love cooking with these ingredients, and the staff guided me in choosing the right dal for my first dal makhani. Everything seemed carefully chosen, not just imported in bulk. Now it's my go-to shop for that authentic flavor.
test-2.author: Chiara B.

test-3.highlight: Nothing feels like a random import — genuine quality care
test-3.quote: I ordered Tata Tea Gold and a bag of rajma online, and both arrived quickly and well-packaged. What I appreciate most is that nothing seems like a random import; you can tell they really care about the brands they carry. I will definitely order again.
test-3.author: Anjali D.

aboutPage.title: Who We Are
aboutPage.storyHeading: Exclusive Distributor of Tata Consumer Products in Italy
aboutPage.p1: Shelly Indian Foods is the exclusive distributor of Tata Consumer Products in Italy and has been the go-to address in Cremona for authentic groceries and wholesale supply.
aboutPage.p2: What began as a small family-run shop opened by Avtar and Shelly Grover, and now run by their son Tajinder, has grown into one of the region's most reliable sources for wholesalers and retailers purchasing authentic Indian food products from trusted distributors since 1998.
aboutPage.p3: Every product on our shelves, from a box of Tata Tea Premium to a kilo of unpolished rajma dal, is something we'd happily use in our own kitchen.

stats.stat1Desc: Continuous family operations from Cremona across all Italian regions.
stats.stat2Desc: Direct temperature-controlled sea freight import per year.
stats.stat3Desc: Wholesalers, ethnic stores, and supermarkets nationwide.
stats.stat4Desc: Strict ISO 22000 & HACCP food compliance and batch traceability.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.desc: To continue to grow and expand as a trusted name for authentic Indian food products throughout Italy, bringing the familiar taste of India closer to every home, store, and business. Our goal is to build a strong bridge between trusted Indian food brands and the growing Indian and South Asian community in Italy, while making quality products easier to find and access.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.desc: At Shelly Indian Foods, our mission is to make trusted Indian food products available throughout Italy with reliability, care, and consistency. As the exclusive distributor of Tata Consumer Products in Italy, we ensure wholesalers and customers have access to authentic products they know and trust, from tea to salt to legumes, building reliable and long-lasting distribution relationships.

faqPage.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqPage.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our authentic Indian products, Italian distribution network, wholesale operations, and food safety standards.
faqPage.searchPlaceholder: Search questions (e.g. Tata Tea, Cremona store, delivery)...

faq1.question: Are Shelly Indian Foods products authentic and original?
faq1.answer: Yes. We import directly from India and only carry certified and original brands like Tata Tea, Tata Salt, and Tata Sampann, to guarantee you the true flavor and quality of Indian cuisine, not a substitute.

faq2.question: Where is your store located and can I order Indian food online?
faq2.answer: Our physical store is located in Cremona, at Via Giuseppina 149. You can also order Indian food products online through our shop, with delivery throughout Italy.

faq3.question: Do you supply wholesalers and supermarkets?
faq3.answer: Yes, we work with wholesalers and supermarkets throughout Italy, offering a reliable wholesale supply of Indian food products and consistent quality for long-term partnerships with tiered volume pricing.

faq4.question: What kind of Indian products can I buy from Shelly Indian Foods?
faq4.answer: We carry a wide range of authentic Indian teas (Tata Tea Premium, Gold, Agni), Tata Dal & unpolished pulses (Tata Sampann), Tata Salt, spices, and pantry essentials from trusted brands — everything you need for true Indian cuisine.

faq5.question: How long has Shelly Indian Foods been serving customers?
faq5.answer: We have been serving customers in Cremona and throughout Italy since 1998, with over 25 years of importing authentic Indian tea and food products.
